title: Character bios: background and everyday life
question: Which proposed details would you keep or change?

options.label: mio · Mio
options.note: A private gamer working on a tactics game under an online name. Proposed details include sharing a bedroom as a child, her island room and the games she spends her evenings playing.

options.label: kenji · Kenji
options.note: A new engineer living away from his parents for the first time. Proposed details include the family bicycle shop, his half-built spacecraft models and his wish to handle a job alone.

options.label: kuro · Kuro
options.note: A domineering flirt with a taste for comfort and attention. Proposed details include hotel work, a staff apartment, a difficult former relationship and the seafront home she wants to buy.

options.label: rei · Rei
options.note: An abrasive saleswoman aiming for management. Proposed details include her island childhood, her life near the tennis courts and an ankle injury she tries to ignore.

decision: Approved as the foundation: "Very good, this is a solid foundation to build on. MAKE SURE this approach is consistently applied going forward, both for bio writing and prose in general (avoiding slop writing)". Next: one Claude agent per character (#368).
